heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. Apply to BCCNM and pass an approved exam ([how to apply](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/applications_registration/how_to_apply/Pages/Default.aspx)).
2. Once licensed, apply for an MSP practitioner number with [Form 2998](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/health/forms/2998fil.pdf), and enrol in PRIME for PharmaNet ([Prescribing Authority](Prescribing%20Authority.md)).
3. Each year, finish your [Personal Practice Review](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/QA/ppr/Pages/Default.aspx) and [renew](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/applications_registration/how_to_renew/Pages/Default.aspx) by March 31.

heading: How to Do It in Ontario
title:
1. Apply to [CNO](https://www.cno.org/en/become-a-nurse/new-applicants1/nurse-practitioner/), pass the NP registration exam and write the [jurisprudence exam](https://cno.org/become-a-nurse/examinations/jurisprudence-examination).
2. If your program did not cover controlled substances, complete an [approved course](https://www.cno.org/standards-learning/nurse-practitioners/nps-and-prescribing-controlled-substances/approved-controlled-substances-education-for-nurse-practitioners).
3. [Renew](https://cno.org/maintain-your-membership/annual-membership-renewal) each year and keep up with [Quality Assurance](https://www.cno.org/standards-learning/nurse-practitioners/quality-assurance-resources-for-nps).
